test_title: PYST 15: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western qurter.
After anchoring, the wind was varieable and light from the western quarter.
After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western quarter.
After anchoring, the wind was variable and lite from the westen quarter.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western quarter".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"variable"** means something that is not consistent or having a fixed pattern; it can change. (परिवर्तनीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The weather in the mountains is highly variable, making it hard to predict.
 
 
 
• **"Quarter"** refers to one of four equal or corresponding parts into which something is or can be divided. (चौथाई)
 
 
• **Example: **The city is divided into four quarters, each with its own unique character.
 
 
 
• Only in **option 3**, all the words are correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: "After anchoring, the wind was variable and light from the western qurter."

 
 
• **Qurter** (quarter) (चौथाई): The correct spelling is "quarter".
 
• **Example:** He lives in the northern quarter of the city.
 
 
 
• **Option 2**: "After anchoring, the wind was varieable and light from the western quarter."
 
 
• **Varieable** (variable) (परिवर्तनीय): The correct spelling is "variable".
 
• **Example:** The stock market can be highly variable.
 
 
 
• **Option 4**: "After anchoring, the wind was variable and lite from the westen quarter."
 
 
• **Lite** (light) (हल्का): The correct spelling is "light".
 
• **Example:** He prefers lite meals in the evening.
 
• **Westen** (western) (पश्चिमी): The correct spelling is "western".
 
• **Example:** They live in the western part of the country.
 
 

33:Td57,

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To do so
